reason: PURE is the only one I'd even look at, because citrate wrecks my stomach and the Complex has it. The first thing I noticed was the pocket-size sachets, which suit me since I forget pills at home. But $29.99 is a lot when I already have a drawer of half-used bottles.
objection: I'd pay about a dollar a day for something I might stop taking after a week, and I've done that already with other bottles. Magnesium is magnesium to me, so why pay extra for the box?
would_change_my_mind: A cheaper first box (around $19 to $20) or a small trial pack of 7 sachets, so I can check my stomach is fine before paying for 30.
